review.evidence: Awaiting independent S review at this HEAD: ADR 0012 plugin bootstrap (8-field manifest, requires semantics, registration/root single-write route), read-only preview boundary (no tables/no persistence/no ledger/source consumption/canonical event), template detection/mapping/row precheck, permissions/module disable, idempotency-free read-only contract and the disclosed deviations (temporary empty manifest requires/migration_dependencies with service-layer dependency gate; no onboarding 0001; in-memory conflicts; auditor HTTP run 403). projectctl check, check and the scoped tests pass; verify-change is review-gated until the reviewer records pass. deviations: Dependency guard vs existing test whitelist (Lead decision: option 1, restore ADR contract). PH-274 spec/ADR 0012 freeze manifest requires={contracts,settlement,cash} (and matching migration_dependencies); registering that guard makes 7 existing disable-loop test files fail (tests/test_acceptance_revenue.py, tests/test_v1_cash_http.py, tests/test_v1_clearance_http.py, tests/test_v1_settlement_http.py, tests/test_v1_contract_change.py, tests/test_v1_contract_change_http.py, tests/test_service_period_revenue_http.py), none of which are inside the PH-274 allowed_paths. The Lead ruled option 1: the PH-282 planning slot will add those 7 files to the PH-274 allowed_paths (PH-269 precedent) and supply a corrected BASE. On rebase, this slice will restore manifest requires={contracts,settlement,cash} and the ADR migration_dependencies, keep the service-layer dependency gate as defence in depth, and in each of the 7 loops disable onboarding first with minimal edits that do not change business assertion semantics. Until that corrected BASE lands, this HEAD keeps requires={} and migration_dependencies=[] as a disclosed temporary fallback.

No onboarding 0001 migration: the main PH-274 spec freezes no business tables, no ImportPreview/ImportConflict persistence and no migrations/0001_initial.py. The Lead's task message mentioned an own 0001 migration and canonical conflict persistence; the spec was followed (bootstrap app only, in-memory ephemeral conflict projection), and the conflict is disclosed rather than silently changing the contract.

Conflict list is an in-memory ephemeral projection with canonical-like fields (kind=import_conflict, ephemeral=true, row_number/code/field/message/severity) returned per response; nothing is persisted and no ImportPreview/ImportConflict table exists. This satisfies the spec's '不做冲突持久化' while still giving PH-271 a canonical-shaped preview payload.

Auditor HTTP preview run returns 403: the plugin runtime binds POST routes to business_write and calls require_write, which excludes auditor. The service layer allows auditor (tested) and the templates page is readable by auditor; if an HTTP read-only preview channel for auditor is required, it needs a runtime access extension/planning decision. The list page remains available to auditor.

Preview header mapping is intentionally lenient (required columns must be present; extra columns become unmapped_columns) per the spec's mapped_fields/unmapped requirement, while core.imports.parse_csv remains strict and unchanged; preview does not call the strict parser and performs its own read-only row validation.

Preview performs one generic audit write (onboarding.import_previewed) as the spec allows; it is the only durable write. The generic audit helper also emits its ordinary non-canonical outbox DomainEvent for the action name; no canonical topic/command/schema is added.
Single worker owns the whole write set (onboarding plugin files, settings/delivery wiring, tests, governance); no parallel slice writes these files; independent review is pending.
